report.back.description: Button that goes back to the previous step of the report dialog, keeping the answers.

report.category.heading.defaultMessage: Por que você está denunciando esta conta?
report.category.heading.description: Heading of the first step of the report dialog, which also names the group of reasons.

report.category.legal.description: Reason of a report: the account posts content that is against the law.

report.category.legal.description.defaultMessage: Conteúdo que você acredita ser contra a lei.
report.category.legal.description.description: Explanation of the illegal content reason of a report.

report.category.other.description: Reason of a report that is none of the others.

report.category.other.description.description: Explanation of the other reason of a report.

report.category.required.description: Error under the reasons of a report when the user went on without choosing one.

report.category.spam.description: Reason of a report: the account posts spam or unwanted promotion.

report.category.spam.description.defaultMessage: Anúncios, links indesejados ou a mesma publicação repetida várias vezes.
report.category.spam.description.description: Explanation of the spam reason of a report.

report.category.violation.description: Reason of a report: the account breaks the rules of this server. The next step lists the rules.

report.category.violation.description.defaultMessage: Você escolhe as regras na próxima etapa.
report.category.violation.description.description: Explanation of the rule violation reason of a report.

report.close.description: Accessible name of the × button of the report dialog. Nothing is sent.

report.comment.characters_left.description: Character count under the comment of a report while the text is within the limit.

report.comment.characters_over.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# caractere a mais} other {# caracteres a mais}}
report.comment.characters_over.description: Character count under the comment of a report when the text is longer than the limit.

report.comment.description.defaultMessage: Opcional. Só os moderadores o leem.
report.comment.description.description: Hint under the comment field of a report: the reported account never sees it.

report.comment.heading.defaultMessage: Mais alguma coisa que os moderadores devam saber?
report.comment.heading.description: Heading of the last step of the report dialog, with the comment and, for another server's account, forwarding.

report.comment.label.description: Label of the comment field of a report.

report.comment.too_long.defaultMessage: Reduza o comentário para {max, number} caracteres ou menos.
report.comment.too_long.description: Error under the comment of a report that is longer than the limit. {max} is a number.

report.done.description: Button that closes the report dialog after the report was sent.

report.failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível enviar a denúncia: {reason}
report.failed.description: Error in the report dialog when sending the report failed; the answers are kept. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

report.forward.description: Checkbox in the report dialog for an account of another server. {domain} is that server's domain.

report.forward.description.defaultMessage: Os moderadores de {domain} recebem uma cópia sem o seu nome.
report.forward.description.description: Explanation under the checkbox that forwards a report to the account's server. {domain} is that server's domain.

report.next.description: Button that goes on to the next step of the report dialog.

report.open.description: Menu item on another account's post or profile that opens the dialog to report the account to the moderators.

report.posts.content_warning.description: Shown instead of the text of a post with a content warning in the report dialog. {text} is the warning the author wrote.

report.posts.description.defaultMessage: Escolha as publicações que os moderadores devem analisar. Você também pode denunciar a conta sem elas.
report.posts.description.description: Hint under the heading of the posts step of the report dialog.

report.posts.empty.defaultMessage: Esta conta não tem publicações que você possa escolher.
report.posts.empty.description: Shown in the posts step of the report dialog when the account has no posts the user can see.

report.posts.failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível carregar as publicações
report.posts.failed.description: Heading of the error in the posts step of the report dialog when its posts did not load.

report.posts.heading.description: Heading of the step of the report dialog that lists the account's posts; it also names the group of posts.

report.posts.item.description: Label of the checkbox of one post in the report dialog. {date} is the date and time of the post. The post's text follows as the description.

report.posts.loading.description: Accessible name of the spinner while the report dialog loads the account's posts.

report.posts.media.description: Shown for a post in the report dialog that has media attachments.

report.posts.retry.description: Button that loads the posts of the report dialog again after a failure.

report.rules.description.defaultMessage: Escolha todas as regras que se aplicam.
report.rules.description.description: Hint under the heading of the rules step of the report dialog.

report.rules.heading.description: Heading of the step of the report dialog that lists the server rules; it also names the group of rules.

report.rules.required.description: Error in the rules step of the report dialog when the user went on without choosing a rule.

report.sent.body.defaultMessage: Os moderadores vão analisá-la. A conta não é informada de quem denunciou.
report.sent.body.description: Text of the report dialog after the report was sent.

report.sent.forwarded.defaultMessage: Uma cópia sem o seu nome vai para {domain}.
report.sent.forwarded.description: Text of the report dialog after a report that is forwarded to the account's server was sent. {domain} is that server's domain.

report.sent.heading.description: Heading of the report dialog after the report was sent.

report.step.description: Shown above the heading of each step of the report dialog. {current} and {total} are numbers; the total depends on the chosen reason.

report.submit.description: Button on the last step of the report dialog that sends the report to the moderators.

report.title.description: Title of the dialog that reports an account to the moderators. {name} is the account's display name.

report.title_room.description: Title of the dialog that reports a voice chat room to the moderators. {room} is the room's name.

report.room.category.heading.defaultMessage: Por que você está denunciando esta sala?
report.room.category.heading.description: Heading of the first step of the dialog that reports a voice chat room, which also names the group of reasons.

report.room.target.defaultMessage: A denúncia é sobre esta sala e seu anfitrião, {name}.
report.room.target.description: Text above the reasons of the dialog that reports a voice chat room. {name} is the host's display name.
